newsitem.title: FINLAND: S&P, MOODY'S DUE TO VISIT FINLAND SOON - MINISTRY.
newsitem.headline: S&P, MOODY'S DUE TO VISIT FINLAND SOON - MINISTRY.

text.p: Credit rating agencies Standard &
Poor's and Moody's are paying their annual visits to Finland in
the next few weeks, a senior official at the finance ministry's
department of financing said on Tuesday.
"Yes they (rating agencies) will be here for normal, routine
visits," director of finance Kari Nars told Reuters by
telephone. Standard & Poor's representatives will be in Helsinki
early next week, and the team from Moody's the week after.
"We will give them a thorough and in-depth presentation of
the (Finnish) economy and on the outlook for the economy," Nars
said.
He declined comment on expectations that the rating agencies
might upgrade Finland's credit ratings.
The government has expressed hopes recently that Finland's
credit ratings would be upgraded.
The Republic of Finland currently has the following
long-term foreign currency debt ratings:
Standard & Poor's AA-/outlook positive
issued August/95
Moody's Aa2
issued January/92
IBCA AA/outlook positive
issued March/96
--Veera Heinonen, Helsinki newsroom +358 - 9 - 680 50 240
